tool.name: Ndx2resttop
tool.description: : Generate a restrained topology from an index NDX file.

param.name: input_ndx_path
param.label: input NDX file
param.help: Path to the input NDX index file. Format: [input].ndx

param.name: input_top_zip_path
param.label: input ZIP file
param.help: Path the input TOP topology in zip format. Format: [input].zip

param.name: outname_output_top_zip_path
param.label: output ZIP name
param.help: Path the output TOP topology in zip format Format: [output].zip

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: posres_names
param.label: posres_names
param.help: Space-separated preprocessor macro names, one per triplet (e.g. ``"CHAIN_A_POSRES CHAIN_B_POSRES"``). Activated at grompp time via ``-D <name>``. Must match the length of ref_rest_mol_triplet_list.

param.name: force_constants
param.label: force_constants
param.help: Three space-separated force constants Fx Fy Fz in kJ/mol/nm². Written verbatim into each ITP line so the same value is applied to every restrained atom.

param.name: ref_rest_mol_triplet_list
param.label: ref_rest_mol_triplet_list
param.help: Comma-separated triplets ``(reference_group, restrain_group, molecule_name)``, one per molecule to restrain.``reference_group``: NDX group containing *all* atoms of the molecule in global (system-wide) GROMACS numbering. Used only as a coordinate frame to convert global indices to molecule-local 1-based indices. Example: ``r_1-9280``. ``restrain_group``: NDX group with the subset of atoms to actually restrain (must be a strict subset of reference_group). Example: ``P_&_r_1-9280``. ``molecule_name``: the ``[ moleculetype ]`` name in the topology used to locate where to splice the ``#ifdef`` block. Example: ``1TSR``.

tool.help:
